data_gaps: No authoritative site, protection-zone, or buffer-zone boundary geometry is present.
No repository candidate has completed feature-level identity, geometry, destination-membership, heritage-classification, provenance, and institutional review gates.
Existing name-matched sub-features and nearby facilities remain review candidates and are not promoted by this scope contract.
institutional_actions_required: The project governance owner must coordinate an authoritative site and applicable protection or buffer boundary source, followed by technical and subject-matter review.
Supply surveyed feature records with stable source identifiers, bilingual identity, classification, geometry method, accuracy, rights, and destination-membership evidence.
Record independent institutional decisions for identity, coordinate, destination membership, media rights, and publication before any runtime promotion.

review_inventory.identity_policy: Content-derived IDs bind source database and layer identity, all preserved source attributes, and coordinates; mutable ArcGIS OIDs are not sole identities.
review_inventory.classification_policy: Review-only name-evidence routing; proximity and repeated names do not deduplicate, approve, or establish canonical identity.
review_inventory.media_policy: Attachment references are preserved as source values only and grant no ownership, usage rights, identity, or publication authority.
